text = (value['filter'] or '').strip().lower()
	rows = [dict(r) for r in value['data']]
	#Toolroom: tools off the machine that need work before they go back on
	if value['toolroomOnly']:
		needs = ('Due for PM', 'Due for refurbishment', 'Due for calibration', 'Over limit', 'In repair', 'Damaged')
		rows = [r for r in rows if not r['isMounted'] and r['status'] in needs]
	if not text: return rows
	return [r for r in rows if text in (r['toolingPath'] or '').lower() or text in (r['status'] or '').lower()]

config.script:
# The selected tools, or every tool the list shows
	rows = self.view.custom.selectedData or self.view.custom.rows or []
	ids = [r['toolingAssetId'] for r in rows]
	if not ids:
		system.kanoa.toast.show({'type': 'warning', 'message': 'No tools to export'})
		return

	data, msg = system.kanoa.tooling.exportTools({'toolingAssetIdList': ids})
	if msg:
		system.kanoa.toast.show({'type': 'error', 'message': 'Export failed. %s' % msg})
		return

	tools = data['data']['tools']
	label = tools[0]['assetName'] if len(tools) == 1 else 'Tools'
	for character in '\\/:*?"<>|':
		label = label.replace(character, '-')
	fileName = '%s (%s).json' % (label, system.date.format(system.date.now(), 'yyyy-MM-dd HH.mm.ss'))
	system.perspective.download(fileName, system.util.jsonEncode(data))

	system.kanoa.toast.show({'type': 'success', 'message': '%d tool(s) exported' % len(tools)})
	return

onChange.script:
data = self.props.params.data or None
	if data is None: return
	self.props.params.data = None

	#preview (dry run) before anything is written
	data = system.util.jsonDecode(system.util.jsonEncode(data))
	system.perspective.openPopup('toolsImport', 'kanoa/mes/config/tooling/toolsImport', params={'data': data},
		title='Import Tools', modal=True, draggable=True, resizable=True, viewportBound=True, showCloseIcon=True)

	return

# Every selected row: Edit and Delete need exactly one, Export takes them all. selection.data only has the
	# table's columns (no toolingAssetId), so match each selected row to its full row by its unique path
	selected = system.util.jsonDecode(system.util.jsonEncode(self.props.selection.data or []))
	paths = set(r.get('toolingPath') for r in selected)
	self.view.custom.selectedData = [dict(r) for r in self.view.custom.rows or [] if r['toolingPath'] in paths]
	return

customMethods.script:
# A tool that was used comes back "Has history: ..."; it can be retired (and disabled) instead, keeping that history
	result, msg = system.kanoa.tooling.deleteTool(toolingAssetId, retireIfUsed, self.view.custom.security.userId)
	if msg and msg.startswith('Has history:') and not retireIfUsed:
		text = msg[len('Has history:'):].strip() + ' Retiring sets it Retired and disabled, and keeps its history.'
		payload = {'toolingAssetId': toolingAssetId, 'name': name, 'retire': True}
		system.perspective.openPopup('toolDeleteConfirm', 'kanoa/core/templates/inputs/confirm',
			{'text': text, 'messageHandler': 'toolDeleteConfirm', 'inputPayload': payload},
			title='Retire tool', modal=True, overlayDismiss=True)
		return
	if msg:
		system.kanoa.toast.show({'type': 'error', 'message': msg})
		return
	done = 'deleted' if result == 'deleted' else 'retired and disabled'
	system.kanoa.toast.show({'type': 'success', 'message': '%s %s' % (name, done)})
	self.view.custom.refresh = system.date.now()
	system.perspective.sendMessage('toolingChanged', {})
	return
